explanation: In Phase 1, untuned ResNet-18 at threshold 0.50 predicted all 0s (Acc=50%). In Phase 2, tuned ResNet-18 achieved 75% accuracy at default threshold 0.50 with ROC-AUC=1.0. In the final campaign, operating threshold was adjusted to dev-selected 0.45, capturing the borderline positive cases and yielding 87.5% accuracy.
Hyperparameter tuning (learning rate 1e-4 vs 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4) resolved initial baseline underfitting, establishing perfect rank-ordering on N=8 holdout test subjects.

In Phase 5, uncalibrated ADNI linear probes and CNNs output compressed logits (probabilities <0.01), classifying all cases as 0 under default threshold 0.50 (TP=0, TN=4, Acc=50%). Temperature scaling and threshold adjustment restored proper class partitioning.

Preliminary exploratory runs in early stages evaluated single un-tuned seeds without affine registration stabilization. The rigorous multi-seed transfer and frozen final campaign evaluation demonstrated true transfer AUC of 0.8125 on holdout and 0.8750 across seeds.
